title: Transcript (word-level captions)
description: A JSON array of word-level tokens shaped like the @remotion/captions Caption type. Timestamps are absolute milliseconds from the start of the media and tokens are in chronological order.

text.description: One word/token as Whisper emits it, including any leading space.

startMs.description: Absolute start time in milliseconds from the start of the media.

endMs.description: Absolute end time in milliseconds. Must be >= startMs.

timestampMs.description: Midpoint of startMs and endMs, or null if unknown.

confidence.description: Confidence 0-1, or null if the model does not provide it.
